primary_collagen_context.finding: Technical critique targets the 2021 de Miranda and 2023 Pu reviews, not the 2025 funding-stratified or July 2026 updated review. Dose slopes are not the same estimand as pooled treatment effects. Reports SEM/SD mix-ups, modality mixing and extracted sample issues. Reanalysis is also subject to verification, including PA-002.
primary_collagen_context.chart_rule: Do not plot dose coefficient alongside treatment SMD as interchangeable; interval level to verify from model output.

primary_collagen_context.funding: Authors declare no conflicts; cash funding not established from abstract; primary funding not thereby established.
primary_collagen_context.limitations: No direct pregnancy outcomes; review overlap likely; structural wrinkle, density and roughness findings unstable in sensitivity analyses. Full PMC access blocked; primary extraction remains incomplete.

numerics.rules: No automatic pooling or independent-study count; exact interval level, endpoint, population, comparator, units and timing required. Primary-audit dose coefficients and SMD remain context until reconciliation. Keep original research panel notes.

import_policy: Do not load original chart interval files plus consolidated intervals again. Prefer expanded nutrient table for its covered scope; retain legacy as context only. Unknown/different units, indication, timepoints, sources, population or uncertainty are not interchangeable. No patient data. Clinical review and app-level tests required before medical release. Release-safety audit RP-C01–05 controls over older claims wherever scope overlaps; quarantine RP001 and hold RP005 numerical charts. Product comparisons use family alias mapping; visual specifications are drafts.

product_catalog_reconciliation.rule: Three duplicate product families; do not duplicate catalog cards. Retain both time-stamped price observations if package/merchant differs; never infer same SKU without matching pack and label. Product IDs are not clinical source IDs. Seven plus five minus three = nine product/category examples.
